name: craftium
description: Build in Minecraft by chatting: Claude previews builds as a ghost in your game and applies them when you say so. Includes a builder skill for well-proportioned builds.

minecraft_dir.title: Minecraft folder
minecraft_dir.description: Only needed if your game does not use the default .minecraft folder (for example a Prism, Modrinth App or CurseForge profile). Choose the profile's game folder, the one that contains config and mods. To copy its path, open the game, then the AI menu > AI status and setup, and press Copy game folder (shown as "This game's folder").
